definitions.explanation: a person who wins an election
a person who wins a prize in a drawing, raffle, or lottery

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In this election, there were many first-time winners.

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{選挙管理委員会|せんきょかんりいいんかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The elected candidates receive formal notification from the election commission.

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賞品|しょうひん}→賞品：21558_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will deliver the prize to the winner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五名|ごめい}です。

{当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧⟦{代|か}えさせて→代える：11717_kaeru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: The announcement of the winners will be made by the delivery of the prizes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧ (winning an election; winning a prize) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The word covers both election winners and prize/lottery winners, reflecting the dual meaning of ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement of winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}する→通知する：19645_tsuuchisuru⟧: to notify the winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of winners

USAGE:
The set phrase {当選者|とうせんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧⟦{代|か}えさせて→代える：11717_kaeru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ ("the announcement of winners will take the form of prize shipment") is a stock disclaimer found in Japanese prize campaigns, meaning winners will not be publicly announced but will simply receive their prize.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {落選者|らくせんしゃ}: losing candidate — the antonym in election contexts
- ⟦{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}→受賞者：24174_jushousha⟧: award recipient — for formal awards and honors, not elections or lotteries
- {入選者|にゅうせんしゃ}: person selected/shortlisted — often used for art contests and literary prizes
